learning_outcomes.text: Acquire theoretical, technical, and design knowledge of both medium and low voltage electrical power systems.
Understand the structure and operation of medium and low voltage electrical power systems.
Define and dimension the best distribution system layout, allowing correct coordination with overcurrent, overvoltage, and ground fault protection systems.
Choose and calculate the electric loads required for every building service (lighting, motive power and energy in general).
Design an electrical power system guaranteeing both energy efficiency and electrical safety.

syllabus_topics: Conventional load and main types of users
Types of electrical networks: radial, redundant, ring, meshed
Design calculations: permissible voltage drop method, amperometric moments method, mono and bi-powered ring

Calculation of overcurrents: overload, short circuit, components of the current, crest factor, thermal stress, specific energy, electrodynamic stresses, calculation of the current, current of short circuit
Switching and protection devices: reference characteristics, re-establishment curve, withstand voltage, circuit-breaker, MV circuit-breakers, automatic circuit-breakers for LV
Protection relay, thermal relay, magnetic relay, magneto-thermal release, electronic release, tripping, conventional tripping and non-tripping current, specific through-energy
Fuses, conventional tripping and non-tripping current, current limiting characteristic
Conditions for overcurrent protection: overload protection, short circuit protection, pipeline protection, back up protection, selectivity of protections, motor protection

Protection from direct and indirect contacts: mass and extraneous mass, earth resistance, ground potential, contact voltage, effects of current on the human body, safety curve, earth system, earth resistance calculation, earth leakage breaker
Contact protection indirect in systems: TT, TN, IT
Electrical cabins: definitions, typologies, CEI 0-16, connection rules and schemes
Sizing of the MV side components, transformers
Sizing of the LV side components, overcurrent protection, protection against earth faults, protection from internal transformer faults, earthing systems of the cabins
The power factor correction of the plants: origin and consequences of the voltage-current phase shift
Choice, sizing and protection of a power factor correction panel
Overvoltage classification (internal and external origin), coordination of insulation, protection and SPD, lightning protection
Emergency, backup and safety power supply: uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), static UPS, rotating UPS, generators
Obligation of the project, type of project, project documentation
Introduction to Power Quality: definitions and standards, disturbances, the PQ in Italy, continuity indices, voltage quality, user susceptibility, causes of disturbances and mitigation methods
Harmonic distortion, effects of harmonics, filters, technical solutions and economic considerations, classification and main types of compensation systems, PQ costs
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on an oral exam and one electric installation design autonomously implemented. The attendance of lessons and exercitations is highly suggested.
